thread:
zoe.l: Hi all  unexpected family situation so I might need to shift my planned 12-week parental leave earlier by two weeks. Quick checklist: 1) how to update leave start date? 2) can I request an emergency short-term contractor for 4 weeks to cover hiring only? 3) if I return earlier than expected, how do I notify payroll/benefits to stop top-up?
people-ops: Sorry to hear that Zoe  you can edit your leave dates on the internal form here: https://benefits.redwood.com/leave-forms -> choose your existing request and click "Edit dates." If you need a manual update we can process it for you; DM us and we'll take it live.
zoe.l: Thanks. If I change dates now, will that affect SDI/EDD filing? I filed SDI for the original dates already.
people-ops: If SDI claim dates change, you should update CA EDD with the new start date. Upload any updated EDD docs once you get them. Payroll needs the EDD determination PDF to calculate top-up; if dates shift we can still align payments as long as docs are uploaded promptly.
payroll-bot: Reminder: for top-up timing, docs must be in portal by the payroll cutoff (last day of the pay period that includes your first paid leave day) otherwise top-up is delayed one pay cycle. Retro adjustments possible after docs are received.
andrew-eng: For hiring coverage, I can triage offers and screens for 2 weeks. If you want an external contractor for 4 weeks, ping recruiter-liz with a 3-line scope and she'll try to fast-track.
recruiter-liz: Yep I can spin up a contractor. Liz here  drop the scope, hours, and desired start date and Ill queue approval. We can usually approve a 4-week contract in ~3 business days if budget is green.
zoe.l: Great  last Q: if I return earlier, what's the process to stop the top-up so payroll doesn't overpay?
people-ops: Send an email to benefits@redwood.com with your actual return-to-work date; well notify Payroll to stop the top-up and process any necessary reconciliation. If payroll already processed an overpayment, we'll reverse or adjust on the next paycheck and communicate details.
facilities: If youre moving dates and need a lactation room/desk reserved upon return, email us at facilities@redwood.com and include the new return date. We can priority-book a room for your first 4 weeks.
zoe.l: Thank you everyone  updating the form now and will DM people-ops for manual help if needed. Appreciate the quick responses :heart:
